test_cases.name: happy_path_full_fsm_lifecycle
test_cases.description: Deterministic progression through all declared states to terminal COMPLETED state with valid guards and atomic actions.
test_cases.input: Execute generic lifecycle FSM fsm-refactor from IDLE through PLANNING, EXECUTING, and VERIFYING to COMPLETED with passing guards.
expected_output_patterns: === FSM INITIALIZED: fsm-refactor InitialState: IDLE ===
[EVENT_RECEIVED] FSM: fsm-refactor Event: START_WORKFLOW State: IDLE
[STATE_TRANSITION] FSM: fsm-refactor From: IDLE Event: START_WORKFLOW To: PLANNING
[EVENT_RECEIVED] FSM: fsm-refactor Event: PLAN_APPROVED State: PLANNING
[STATE_TRANSITION] FSM: fsm-refactor From: PLANNING Event: PLAN_APPROVED To: EXECUTING
[EVENT_RECEIVED] FSM: fsm-refactor Event: TASKS_DONE State: EXECUTING
[STATE_TRANSITION] FSM: fsm-refactor From: EXECUTING Event: TASKS_DONE To: VERIFYING
[EVENT_RECEIVED] FSM: fsm-refactor Event: VERIFY_PASS State: VERIFYING
[STATE_TRANSITION] FSM: fsm-refactor From: VERIFYING Event: VERIFY_PASS To: COMPLETED
=== FSM TERMINATED: fsm-refactor FinalState: COMPLETED Count: 4 ===

test_cases.name: unauthorized_transition_blocked
test_cases.description: Attempt to execute an undefined or illegal transition triggers UNAUTHORIZED_TRANSITION_ATTEMPT and halts execution.
test_cases.input: Execute fsm-deploy-pipeline currently in PLANNING state when event DEPLOY_CODE is received with no registered transition.
expected_output_patterns: [EVENT_RECEIVED] FSM: fsm-deploy-pipeline Event: DEPLOY_CODE State: PLANNING
"violation_code": "UNAUTHORIZED_TRANSITION_ATTEMPT"
No registered transition from state PLANNING on event DEPLOY_CODE
prohibited_output_patterns: [STATE_TRANSITION] FSM: fsm-deploy-pipeline From: PLANNING Event: DEPLOY_CODE To: DEPLOYED

test_cases.name: guard_evaluation_failure_blocks_transition
test_cases.description: Transition lookup succeeds but boolean guard evaluation returns false, discarding event and keeping current state.
test_cases.input: Execute fsm-refactor in VERIFYING state receiving event VERIFY_PASS where all_checks_passed evaluates to false.
expected_output_patterns: [EVENT_RECEIVED] FSM: fsm-refactor Event: VERIFY_PASS State: VERIFYING
[TRANSITION_BLOCKED] FSM: fsm-refactor Event: VERIFY_PASS Reason: Guard evaluation failed
"violation_code": "GUARD_EVALUATION_FAILED"
prohibited_output_patterns: [STATE_TRANSITION] FSM: fsm-refactor From: VERIFYING Event: VERIFY_PASS To: COMPLETED

test_cases.name: atomic_exit_action_failure_halts
test_cases.description: Failure during atomic exit action triggers EXIT_ACTION_FAILED and transitions FSM to FAILED.
test_cases.input: Execute fsm-refactor transitioning from PLANNING to EXECUTING where on_exit_planning throws unhandled disk error.
expected_output_patterns: [EVENT_RECEIVED] FSM: fsm-refactor Event: PLAN_APPROVED State: PLANNING
"violation_code": "EXIT_ACTION_FAILED"
[STATE_TRANSITION] FSM: fsm-refactor From: PLANNING Event: PLAN_APPROVED To: FAILED
prohibited_output_patterns: [STATE_TRANSITION] FSM: fsm-refactor From: PLANNING Event: PLAN_APPROVED To: EXECUTING

test_cases.name: atomic_entry_action_failure_halts
test_cases.description: Failure during atomic entry action triggers ENTRY_ACTION_FAILED and transitions FSM to FAILED.
test_cases.input: Execute fsm-refactor transitioning into EXECUTING state where on_enter_executing throws an initialization exception.
expected_output_patterns: "violation_code": "ENTRY_ACTION_FAILED"
[STATE_TRANSITION] FSM: fsm-refactor From: PLANNING Event: PLAN_APPROVED To: FAILED

test_cases.name: infinite_loop_detection_bound_exceeded
test_cases.description: FSM cycling between operational states exceeds max_transitions bound, tripping INFINITE_LOOP_DETECTED defect.
test_cases.input: Execute fsm-loop-tester with max_transitions set to 10 cycling repeatedly between EXECUTING and VERIFYING.
expected_output_patterns: "violation_code": "INFINITE_LOOP_DETECTED"
=== FSM TERMINATED: fsm-loop-tester FinalState: FAILED

test_cases.name: undeclared_terminal_state_rejection
test_cases.description: Validation detects a dead-end state with zero outgoing transitions that is not declared in terminal_states.
test_cases.input: Validate FsmDefinition with states [IDLE, PROCESSING, STUCK, COMPLETED] where STUCK has no outgoing transitions and is not in terminal_states.
expected_output_patterns: "violation_code": "UNDECLARED_TERMINAL_STATE"
